note: Owner-maintained crisis contacts (plan v3 W6/W8). Every entry must keep source + lastVerifiedAt current: CrisisResourcesReleaseTest fails the build otherwise, and the screen shows the verification date so a stale list is visible, not silent.

resources.name: Kenya Red Cross — Mental Health Hotline
resources.description: Toll-free, 24/7 emotional support and crisis counselling.

resources.name: Befrienders Kenya
resources.description: Confidential suicide-prevention support by phone, SMS, and WhatsApp. Weekdays 9am–5pm.

resources.name: Emergency services
resources.description: Police, ambulance, and fire. If you are in immediate danger, call now.

resources.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
resources.description: Call or text 988 — free, confidential support, 24/7.

resources.name: Crisis Text Line
resources.description: Text HOME to 741741 to reach a crisis counsellor by text, 24/7.

resources.name: SAMHSA National Helpline
resources.description: Free, confidential treatment referral and information for substance use, 24/7.

resources.name: Find A Helpline
resources.description: Verified helplines in over 130 countries — phone, text, and chat, by topic.
